title: MIUT 2027 — Official Regulations
publisher: MIUT – Madeira Island Ultra-Trail / Clube de Montanha do Funchal
claims: The 2027 regulations list five races: MIUT LEGEND 110 km with +7,200 m and -7,200 m and a 32-hour limit, MIUT ADVANCED 80 km with +4,760 m and -4,760 m and 25 hours, MIUT DISCOVER 56 km with +2,800 m and -3,060 m and 15 hours, MIUT MARATHON 40 km with +1,450 m and -2,000 m and 11 hours, and MIUT STARTER 17 km with +510 m and -520 m and 3 h 30 min.

The 2027 schedule gives the LEGEND start as 00:00 on 24 April at Porto Moniz, ADVANCED 07:00 at São Vicente, DISCOVER 09:00 at Boaventura, MARATHON 11:00 at Monte–Funchal and STARTER 08:00 on 25 April at Porto da Cruz; buses leave Machico and Funchal before each start.
The event has approximately 3,800 places, split 80% direct registration and 20% lottery; the place counts are LEGEND 1,000, ADVANCED 600, DISCOVER 600, MARATHON 800 and STARTER 800.

The 2027 fee table is LEGEND EUR 180 / 195, ADVANCED EUR 140 / 160, DISCOVER EUR 110 / 120, MARATHON EUR 90 / 100 and STARTER EUR 40 / 55, with the early tier ending on 30 November 2026 and the late tier running to 15 March 2027.
Direct registration opened race by race at 15:00 Madeira time on 12–16 October 2026; lottery pre-registration ran from 26 October to 9 November 2026 and the draw was on 14 November.

The refund schedule is 85% until 30 November 2026, 50% from 1 December 2026 to 31 January 2027, 30% from 1 February to 15 March 2027 and no refund from 16 March; a distance change costs EUR 15 and is allowed until 20 March 2027.

The 2027 minimum ages are LEGEND 21, ADVANCED 20, DISCOVER 20, MARATHON 20 and STARTER 18; LEGEND needs at least 4 ITRA points or 115 km-effort, ADVANCED 2 points or 45 km-effort, DISCOVER 1 point or 25 km-effort, while MARATHON and STARTER are exempt.
Every runner must upload a medical certificate and complete the medical questionnaire by 20 March 2027.

LEGEND and ADVANCED drop bags go to the Curral das Freiras checkpoint and then to the finish; DISCOVER, MARATHON and STARTER bags go directly from the start to the finish; bags not collected by 12:00 on Sunday are treated as abandoned.

Aid stations serve water, isotonic drink, soft drinks, fruit, sweet and savoury food and hot broth at the main stations; the event has a no-disposable-cups policy, so each runner must carry a cup or liquid container.
Intermediate cut-offs are set at all key checkpoints; the departure time from the checkpoint determines compliance and a runner arriving or leaving after the cut-off is disqualified.

Mandatory equipment for all five races is a visible bib, a tagged backpack, at least 1 litre of water capacity, a 100 x 200 cm thermal blanket, a 100 x 6 cm elastic band or bandage, a waterproof jacket, a working mobile phone, reserve food, a whistle, a personal cup and an identification document; LEGEND and ADVANCED also require a container for solid food with a utensil, two headlamps with spare batteries or a powerbank and a flashing red rear light; DISCOVER requires one headlamp with spare batteries or a powerbank.
Personal assistance is allowed only in LEGEND, ADVANCED and DISCOVER, within 20 m before and after official aid stations, with one assistant per runner; MARATHON and STARTER forbid it.
The organiser may activate a cold-weather kit consisting of a long-sleeved thermal top, waterproof trousers, a hat or buff covering the ears and waterproof gloves.

Check-in and the Expo run at Fórum Machico: 21 April Expo 10:00–21:00 and check-in 13:00–21:00; 22 April Expo 10:00–21:00 and check-in 13:00–21:00 with a 16:45 Legend press conference; 23 April Expo 10:00–22:00 and check-in 10:00–22:00; 24 April Expo 10:00–21:00 and check-in 09:00–12:00.
Elite entry: men with ITRA ≥825 and women ≥700 can apply for a complimentary place; men ≥775 and women ≥650 can apply for a guaranteed paid place after sell-out, by 28 February 2027.

Travel bibs: 20 places through the official travel agency with at least five nights of accommodation, deadline 28 February 2027; charity bibs require a EUR 300 donation to one of four partner institutions, confirmed by 31 January 2027.
